brochures.file: PAIDEH-BR_0524 (CA Accident Insurance (PAID Enhanced) - PAID Enhanced Brochure).pdf
notes: An accident-only policy that pays cash on a fixed schedule, in addition to any other insurance.
MyPopPro quotes the 24-hour coverage option (on and off the job); an off-the-job-only option is also filed.
Issue ages 18 - 84; guaranteed renewable for life, subject to ManhattanLife's right to change premium rates.
Choose one or two units. Individual, Individual & Spouse, Individual & Child(ren), and Family.
Optional Annual Wellness Benefit Rider ($60 per covered person per year) is not approved in CA, ID, MI, MO, PA or WA, and is not included in MyPopPro's price.

rows.label: Emergency Room Treatment
rows.note: Treatment sought within 72 hours of the covered accident.

rows.label: Urgent Care Facility
rows.note: Within 60 days of the covered accident. Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Physician's Office Visit
rows.note: Within 60 days of the covered accident. Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Physician Follow-up Office Visits
rows.note: First follow-up within 30 days of the initial office visit.

rows.label: Chiropractor Visit
rows.note: Maximum 5 visits per covered accident.

rows.label: Physical Therapy
rows.note: Up to 10 treatments per covered accident, per covered person; must start within 30 days and take place within six months of the accident.

rows.label: X-Ray
rows.note: Maximum 1 per calendar year.

rows.label: Major Diagnostic Exams (CT, MRI, MRA, EEG, angiogram)
Ambulatory Surgical Center / Outpatient Hospital Facility
rows.note: Maximum 1 per accident.

rows.label: Concussion
rows.note: Diagnosed by a physician. Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Hospital / ICU Admission
rows.note: Confined within 180 days (minimum 20 hours). Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Hospital Confinement
rows.note: Confined within 180 days. Maximum of 365 days.

rows.label: Hospital Intensive Care Unit Confinement
rows.note: Within 30 days of the accident; maximum 15 days; paid in addition to hospital confinement.

rows.label: Rehabilitation Unit — Admission
rows.note: First day transferred to a rehabilitation unit; not paid on the same day(s) as hospital confinement.

rows.label: Rehabilitation Unit
rows.note: Limited to 30 days per confinement and 60 days per calendar year.

rows.label: Coma
rows.note: Comatose in a hospital at least seven days. Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Lodging (companion)
rows.note: Insured confined more than 100 miles from home. Maximum 30 days.

rows.label: Transportation
rows.note: Hospital more than 100 miles round trip from home. Three round trips per covered accident.

rows.label: Ground Ambulance
rows.note: Within 90 days. Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Air Ambulance
rows.note: Within 48 hours. Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Fractures
rows.note: Surgical or non-surgical reduction within 90 days; the policy has the full schedule.

rows.label: Dislocations
rows.note: Diagnosed within 90 days; the policy has the full schedule.

rows.label: Lacerations
rows.note: Repaired by a physician within 72 hours; based on length.

rows.label: Burns
rows.note: Treated within 72 hours; by size and degree.

rows.label: Surgery (thoracic, open abdominal)
rows.note: Within 72 hours to repair internal injuries. Hernia repair not covered.

rows.label: Tendon / Ligament / Rotator Cuff
rows.note: Surgical repair within 90 days.

rows.label: Knee Cartilage — Torn
rows.note: Treated within 60 days; repaired within 180 days.

rows.label: Ruptured Disc
rows.note: Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Eye Injury
rows.note: Requires surgery or removal of a foreign object, within 90 days.

rows.label: Emergency Dental Work
rows.note: Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Gunshot Wounds (primary insured)
rows.note: Confinement within 24 hours and surgery within 72 hours.

rows.label: Blood, Plasma, and Platelets
rows.note: Within 90 days. Once per covered accident.

rows.label: Epidural Pain Management
rows.note: Per covered accident, per covered person.

rows.label: Appliances (wheelchair, brace, walker, crutches)
rows.note: Per covered accident, per covered person.

rows.label: Prosthesis
rows.note: Once per covered accident, per covered person.

rows.label: Accidental Death
rows.note: Within 90 days of the accident. Doubled on a common carrier (plane, bus, train).

rows.label: Accidental Dismemberment
rows.note: Once per covered person, per covered accident.
